title: Data fiduciary obligations - a checklist every business needs
p1:
Your customers trust you with their data. But are you treating that trust like a responsibility?

Many businesses think data protection is only about avoiding breaches. The bigger challenge is knowing what you are collecting, why you need it, and how you handle it.
p2: A data fiduciary is simply an organisation that decides how and why personal data is processed. The surprising part? Even a small business collecting customer names, phone numbers, emails, or payment details may have responsibilities that go beyond just storing information safely.
p3:
A practical checklist starts with three questions: Are we collecting only the data we actually need? Have we clearly informed people about its use? Are we protecting it through proper security measures and responsible access controls?

Good data practices are not just compliance requirements. They build customer confidence and reduce business risks before problems arise.
